description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as they train for up to 250,000 seconds. The x-axis represents “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents “Loss,” also on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The “Vanilla” model is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers and a dashed line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50 by 250,000 seconds. The “SepLLM” model is shown by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.75 and declining to about 2.47 by 250,000 seconds. Both lines show a general downward trend, with the “SepLLM” model consistently achieving lower loss values than the “Vanilla” model throughout the training period. A horizontal green dashed line at a loss value of 2.50 is present, and a green dashed rectangle highlights the region from approximately 200,000 to 250,000 seconds on the x-axis.
